text:
maria: FYI I'm seeing a missing audit event for a manual RBAC change done in the console ~1h ago. role change shows up in DB but audit log has no \"actor\". Can anyone confirm?
jamal: which change? grantee id or role?
maria: service account team-service-account@redwood was granted \"dedicated-admin\" via console. DB row: grantee=service_account_128, role=dedicated-admin, grant_ts=2026-03-20T10:12:03Z.
sam: do we see any audit event for that timestamp at all? maybe actor null but event exists
audit-bot: Detected audit event: {\"event_type\":\"role_grant\",\"resource\":\"service_account_128\",\"actor\":null,\"ts\":\"2026-03-20T10:12:03Z\"} (indexed into audits-2026.03)
alex: actor null — that matches a known gap when requests come through the legacy frontend path (/v1/rbac) which bypassed the auth middleware. We patched the backend but console might still be calling the old endpoint.
emma: can you paste the request id / app logs?
maria: nginx access log shows req=abcd1234. App trace: TRACE rbac_controller.grant_role svc=console path=/v1/rbac/grant req_id=abcd1234 user_id=null
jamal: repro steps?
maria: repro: 1) login via console UI as admin; 2) grant role to service account; 3) query /internal/audit/events?query=service_account_128 — returns one event with actor=null. curl to repro: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -X POST https://console.internal/api/v1/rbac/grant -d '{\"grantee\":\"service_account_128\",\"role\":\"dedicated-admin\"}' -v
sam: hypothesis: console isn't sending the X-Signature (session-signed header). Auth middleware sees missing signature and sets actor=null but still allows the grant. That should be a hard fail.
alex: that would line up with the AUTH_MIDDLEWARE change in PR #4382. We reverted partially but looks like one instance still had the flag off.
sre-oncall: compliance impact: P1. Missing actor on role_grant events breaks our auditability for policy changes. Assigning jamal + alex to fix and sam for backfill. Also add alert to catch actor==null for role_* events.
jamal: I'll create the alert and start investigating the deploy config.
alex: looking at traces now — console requests to /v1/rbac/grant are routed to app instance r-5. Instance r-5 shows env AUTH_MIDDLEWARE=disabled. That explains it.
emma: r-5 shouldn't be on the old flag. Deploy from yesterday apparently skipped that host. Starting rolling update.
maria: action items: (1) jamal add alert rule to fire on audit.role_grant where actor==null; (2) alex trigger rolling update to enable middleware on r-5; (3) sam write backfill to populate missing actor by correlating req_id -> session store -> user; (4) audit team to run compliance report for last 24h and enumerate role grants with actor null.
sam: I'll start the backfill script. Need DB read access + session store access. ETA ~2h.
jamal: alert created: rule ar-20260320-1 -> fires when count(audit.role_grant where actor==null) > 0 over 5m -> PagerDuty.
sre-oncall: temporary mitigation: WAF rule to block UI calls to /v1/rbac/grant and return 403 with message to use /v2/rbac. Deploying now.
audit-bot: Backfill job queued job_id=bf-904, estimated 90 minutes.
alex: rolling update completed on r-5 at 1765432150, env flipped.
maria: verified new grants now include actor. sample audit event: {\"event_type\":\"role_grant\",\"resource\":\"service_account_129\",\"actor\":\"maria\",\"ts\":\"2026-03-20T10:19:10Z\"}
sam: backfill started, processing events 0-1000.
sre-oncall: will close P1 after backfill completes and compliance report is uploaded.
maria: thanks all — please post when backfill + report done.
